## 5 — Decisions applied

### 5.1 DEFAULTs (structural best practice, no ADR needed)

| DEFAULT | What | Source |
|---|---|---|
| D-P2-01 | Identifier transformation camelCase → UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, unquoted; tables `INV_` + entity name | engine §3; given table naming (`MDL_LOOKUP_TYPE`, `CORE_NUMBER_SERIES`) |
| D-P2-02 | Column order per table: PK → entity fields in SRS order → FK fields → kind standard fields → TENANT_ID, VERSION → CURRENCY_CODE → audit fields; DBF sequence continuous across tables in ENT order | engine §2 ASSIGNMENT RULES |
| D-P2-03 | Audit user columns CREATED_BY / UPDATED_BY are `VARCHAR(100)` holding the platform principal, filled by the given auditing — never a client value, never a numeric FK | engine §3 AUDIT COLUMNS; SRS A3 ("system-filled") |
| D-P2-04 | Closed lookups that hold behaviour (INV_MOVE_TYPE, INV_DOC_STATUS, INV_RESERVATION_STATUS) are CHECK-constrained; open lookups (INV_ADJUSTMENT_REASON, INV_SOURCE_DOC_TYPE) and the consumed CAT unit of measure are validated against active `mdl` values at runtime; INV_CHANGE_KIND is an event field with no column, seeded only | SRS A6, A7; engine §1 (A7 → check constraints); profile LOOKUPS |
| D-P2-05 | IDEMPOTENCY_KEY is indexed, not unique: one cross-module request records several moves or reservations under one key (multi-line receipts and issues, bundle explosion REQ-INV-049 / 053, FEFO split REQ-INV-110); "first result, nothing new" is a service lookup by key (RULE-INV-024); the rows a key returns carry REQUEST_HASH, and a different hash is refused (RULE-INV-050, ADR-INV-048). INV-internal documents fill the key from the document (for example the transfer type and identifier) because the column is NOT NULL in SRS A3 — except an opening stock load, whose moves carry `OPENING_STOCK:<client key>` and the hash of the load, so a resubmitted load posts once (ADR-INV-053) | SRS ENT-INV-004, ENT-INV-005; RULE-INV-024 |
| D-P2-06 | One trigger only, on the stock-move ledger: stock-move immutability (RULE-INV-023) is enforced by TRG_INV_STOCK_MOVE_IMMUTABLE as well as by the service (narrowed by ADR-INV-049). Read-only codes and numbers (RULE-INV-001, 010, 030), read-only posted documents (RULE-INV-029), balance / valuation maintenance (REQ-INV-036, 059) and audit (REQ-INV-077, given AuditApi) are service behaviour | engine BLOCK 6, BLOCK 10 |
| D-P2-07 | RULE-INV-034 (an adjustment line changes something) is not a CHECK: AC-INV-111 starts from a saved DRAFT line whose change is zero and expects the posting to refuse it, so the rule is enforced by the service on save and post | SRS AC-INV-111, RULE-INV-034 |
| D-P2-08 | Uniqueness over a nullable lot uses `UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT` (postgresql15+): stock without a lot is one balance, and two lines of the same Variant without a lot collide (AC-INV-109) | REQ-INV-035; RULE-INV-048; SRS D-14 |
| D-P2-09 | Column defaults only where the SRS states the initial value: IS_ACTIVE_FL TRUE, IS_DEFAULT_FL / OFFLINE_FL / LOT_TRACKED_FL / DUAL_QUANTITY_FL FALSE (A3 "false by default"), STATUS_CODE 'DRAFT' (REQ-INV-078, 087, 097) and 'ACTIVE' (REQ-INV-043), VERSION 0. DOC_DATE "today by default" is service-filled in the tenant time zone (RULE-INV-038's time-zone rule), not a database default; CURRENCY_CODE is service-filled from the tenant base currency | SRS A3, A7 |
| D-P2-10 | Intra-module FKs carry no ON DELETE action — master rows are deactivated, never deleted; lines of a DRAFT document are removed by the service | ARCH-5; REQ-INV-089 |
| D-P2-11 | Search indexes are B-tree on each filter column led by TENANT_ID; "contains" matching of names and barcode resolution (CAT CON-CAT-010) are query / service behaviour; this script creates no extension | engine §4.3 |
| D-P2-12 | BLOCK 8 seeds every key INV owns into the given tables: 6 lookup types / 34 values (MDL_*), 5 number series (CORE_NUMBER_SERIES), 3 notification templates (NOTIF_TEMPLATE — INV_NEGATIVE_STOCK, INV_NEAR_EXPIRY, INV_OFFLINE_SALE_INACTIVE), 3 settings platform defaults (CU_APP_CONFIGURATION — INV_ALLOW_NEGATIVE_STOCK, INV_NEAR_EXPIRY_DAYS, INV_MEASURE_UOM_KEY) — idempotent, for the platform tenant. The capability flags `lotExpiry`, `dualQuantity`, `bundles` are not seeded: their owner writes them (SRS A2 out of scope) | engine §4.2; SRS A6, A9, D-04 |
| D-P2-13 | Stock valuation carries no warehouse: SRS POL-INV-021 / ENT-INV-013 value each Variant across the tenant, so it is not a per-location stock row; per-location stock is INV_STOCK_BALANCE. Line tables (transfer, count, adjustment lines) take the warehouse from their header | SRS ENT-INV-013; CM-8 |
| D-P2-14 | Cross-module HARD-FK columns are `BIGINT` exactly as CON-CAT-001 / CON-CAT-002 state; one XM per column so that each pointer maps to one integration block in P3.1 (whose constraint will be composite with TENANT_ID, as every intra-module FK here) | engine §5.1; contract-cat §0 |

### 5.2 ADRs raised by this stage (ADR-INV-014 … ADR-INV-020)

All seven are NON-BREAKING with status ACCEPTED. ADR-INV-014 … 018 were accepted when raised. ADR-INV-019 (repair round 2) was raised BLOCKED, because the only remaining findings were on P1 SRS text, which P2 could not write; it is now ACCEPTED, resolved by ADR-INV-020, and P2 is complete. It was never a structural conflict, and no DBF, XM or SQL depends on it. The write scope of the first run was the two P2 files, so ADR-INV-014 … 017 are recorded here in full (Context · Decision · Consequences · Traces · Status) for the orchestrator to file under `analysis/decisions/INV/ADR-INV-{seq}.md`. ADR-INV-018, ADR-INV-019 and ADR-INV-020 are recorded here and are filed as `analysis/decisions/INV/ADR-INV-018.md`, `ADR-INV-019.md` and `ADR-INV-020.md`. ADR-INV-020 (ACCEPTED) rewords the two SRS cells and so meets the unblock condition of ADR-INV-019, which is ACCEPTED (resolved). The next free ADR id after P2 was ADR-INV-021 (the module's next free id is now ADR-INV-051).

#### ADR-INV-014 — Platform columns TENANT_ID and VERSION on every INV table
- **Context.** SRS A3 lists no tenant or version field. The given `erp-core` 1.6.0 states the tenancy rule "every table carries TENANT_ID" and requires every business entity to extend its `AuditableEntity` (TENANT_ID as Hibernate `@TenantId`, VERSION as the optimistic lock): every table has `TENANT_ID BIGINT NOT NULL`, `FK_<TABLE>_TENANT → CORE_TENANT(ID)`, an index led by TENANT_ID, every UNIQUE composite with TENANT_ID, and `VERSION BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`. The SRS per-tenant rules (RULE-INV-002, 006, 011, 015, 030, 036, 045) need a tenant column to hold. NO-COLUMN-INVENTION admits a column the platform mandates for the entity. The project applied the same rule to PTY (ADR-PTY-035).
- **Decision.** Every INV table carries TENANT_ID and VERSION as platform columns (DBF-INV-008/009, 020/021, 034/035, 059/060, 081/082, 095/096, 108/109, 123/124, 137/138, 152/153, 169/170, 185/186, 198/199, 214/215), traced to the entity and to the REQs that create and update its rows. Every UNIQUE leads with TENANT_ID; every intra-module FK is composite `(TENANT_ID, <FK>)` against a `UQ_<TABLE>_TENANT_PK`; the script is one Flyway migration with no BEGIN / COMMIT.
- **Consequences.** No INV code reads or writes a tenant identifier (the given fills it). VERSION gives the optimistic lock that, with the per-Variant serialisation of SRS D-09, keeps concurrent moves consistent (REQ-INV-037). A later SRS revision may list `tenantId` / `version` in A3's standard fields; no column changes then.
- **Traces.** REQ-INV-001, REQ-INV-003, REQ-INV-035, REQ-INV-037, REQ-INV-043, REQ-INV-078; RULE-INV-002, RULE-INV-006, RULE-INV-030, RULE-INV-036, RULE-INV-045; ENT-INV-001 … ENT-INV-014.
- **Status.** ACCEPTED — non-breaking.

#### ADR-INV-015 — Currency code on every monetary INV row (profile check CM-8)
- **Context.** Profile check CM-8 (MAJOR) requires every monetary row to carry its currency, "the dimension exists from day one even while the tenant has one". INV holds amounts on Stock move (unitCost, moveValue), Transfer line (unitCost), Stock adjustment line (unitCost, lineValue) and Stock valuation (averageUnitCost, stockValue). SRS A2 and D-06 fix every value "in the tenant base currency" and declare multi-currency an advanced tier, but A3 holds no currency field.
- **Decision.** `CURRENCY_CODE VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL` with `CHECK (CURRENCY_CODE ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')` (ISO 4217) on INV_STOCK_MOVE (DBF-INV-061), INV_TRANSFER_LINE (DBF-INV-110), INV_STOCK_ADJUSTMENT_LINE (DBF-INV-171) and INV_STOCK_VALUATION (DBF-INV-200). The service writes the tenant base currency read through the given `cu` SettingsApi (SRS A9 row 1); there is no column default because the base currency is a tenant setting, not a constant. INV holds no price, so the price-list part of CM-8 does not apply.
- **Consequences.** No SRS meaning changes: every amount stays in the base currency, now stated on the row. The stock-move event (CON-INV-020) may add the code as an ADDITIVE field in P3.1. When multi-currency arrives, valuation per currency is an additive change. A later SRS revision lists `currencyCode` among the fields of the four entities.
- **Traces.** ENT-INV-004, ENT-INV-007, ENT-INV-011, ENT-INV-013; REQ-INV-057, REQ-INV-059, REQ-INV-061, REQ-INV-062, REQ-INV-063, REQ-INV-070, REQ-INV-080, REQ-INV-099; SRS A2 (Currency), D-06.
- **Status.** ACCEPTED — non-breaking.

#### ADR-INV-016 — Physical types the SRS leaves open
- **Context.** SRS A3 gives the scale of every decimal (quantity and measure 3, unit and average cost 4, value 2 — D-06) but no precision; it uses the logical types `date` and `number` (ENT-INV-011.rowNo), which the profile syntax map lacks, and `lookup` without a length.
- **Decision.** Precision 18 for every decimal: `NUMERIC(18,3)` quantities and measures, `NUMERIC(18,4)` costs, `NUMERIC(18,2)` values (15 / 14 / 16 integer digits — far above any trader's stock). Logical `date` → `DATE` (a calendar date; RULE-INV-038 compares the expiry date with today in the tenant time zone, which a timestamp would blur); logical `number` → `INTEGER` (row numbers 1 … 1000, RULE-INV-027). Lookup codes → `VARCHAR(50)` (the given `mdl` convention for a stored code). Each is declared once in the script header.
- **Consequences.** Half-up rounding to the stated scale (SRS D-06) is the service's job; the database stores the scale exactly. A base currency with 3 minor units stores values to 2 decimals as SRS D-06 states; changing that is an SRS decision ("Change the places per tenant currency").
- **Traces.** DBF-INV-027, 042, 044, 045, 159, 177, 192, 193, 194 and every other NUMERIC / DATE / lookup column; REQ-INV-051, REQ-INV-059, REQ-INV-071, REQ-INV-113.
- **Status.** ACCEPTED — non-breaking.

#### ADR-INV-017 — A measure-only adjustment move carries quantity 0
- **Context.** SRS ENT-INV-004.quantity is typed "> 0" (RULE-INV-017 for receipts, issues, reservations and transfers), while REQ-INV-123 posts an adjustment line of a dual-quantity Item whose count change is zero and whose measure change is non-zero "as a measure-only move" (AC-INV-137: on-hand stays 3, measure 120.500 → 120.000). The move needs a quantity value.
- **Decision.** `CHK_INV_STOCK_MOVE_QUANTITY`: QUANTITY > 0, or QUANTITY = 0 only on an ADJUSTMENT_IN / ADJUSTMENT_OUT move whose MEASURE_QTY is greater than 0; the direction of the measure follows the move type, as for the quantity. Every other move keeps QUANTITY > 0, so RULE-INV-017 holds where it applies.
- **Consequences.** A measure-only move has MOVE_VALUE 0 and leaves the average cost unchanged; ACC receives it through the stock-move event with quantity 0. P3.1 documents this on CON-INV-020 (no field changes).
- **Traces.** ENT-INV-004.quantity, ENT-INV-004.measureQty; DBF-INV-042, DBF-INV-043; REQ-INV-123, REQ-INV-099; RULE-INV-017, RULE-INV-034; AC-INV-137.
- **Status.** ACCEPTED — non-breaking.

#### ADR-INV-018 — INV v1 uses no given events subscriber and no given file private store (C-GIVEN-2)
- **Context.** `gov.py analyze` (P2 round 1, C-GIVEN-2) found that the SRS names the given `erp-core:modules.events` subscriber extension point and the given `erp-core:modules.file` private-store interface with no `given-usage` row. Both names sit only in the "Override / status" column of SRS D-23 and D-13 — the alternative that was *not* chosen. The chosen decisions use neither: D-23 has PUR, SLS and SFR call INV operations and INV subscribe to none of their events (the DAG stays downward-only); D-13 has the browser read the opening stock sheet and submit rows, so INV parses no uploaded file. Nothing in this script, the contract or any REQ needs either interface.
- **Decision.** Take the finding's "stop using it" branch, not "add the row": INV v1 declares no use of either interface, and the SRS / contract `given-usage` blocks stay as they are (a row would declare a use that does not exist and would invite a dependency the DAG forbids). No table, column, seed row or XM of this script depends on either interface. The two SRS override cells are to be reworded at the next touch of P1 so that they describe the alternative without naming the interface — "subscribe to their events through the given events module" (D-23) and "server-side import through the given file module once the core publishes the read" (D-13). Adopting either alternative later is an SRS change that adds its `given-usage` row in the SRS and the contract at the same time.
- **Consequences.** No structural change in P2: DBF-INV-001 … 219 and XM-INV-001 … 013 are unchanged. The P2 artifacts cannot clear a finding raised on the SRS text; the finding clears when the two P1 cells are reworded (outside this stage's write scope), with no meaning change to D-13 or D-23.
- **Traces.** SRS D-13, D-23; REQ-INV-070, REQ-INV-071, REQ-INV-073 (opening stock without server-side file parsing); REQ-INV-043, REQ-INV-051, REQ-INV-052 (receipts, issues and reservations by call); ENT-INV-004, ENT-INV-005, ENT-INV-010, ENT-INV-011.
- **Status.** ACCEPTED — non-breaking.

#### ADR-INV-019 — P2 cannot clear the C-GIVEN-2 findings raised on the P1 SRS text; the pass stops
- **Context.** `gov.py analyze` refused P2 a second time (repair round 1) with the same two C-GIVEN-2 findings on artifact `srs`, after ADR-INV-018 took the "stop using it" branch. The two interface names appear only in the SRS D-23 and D-13 "Override / status" cells (`P1/srs-inv.md`, carried into `_state/current-srs.md`). Neither P2 file names them, and the check reads the SRS text only. Both remedies the finding offers ("add the row" or "stop using it") are P1 edits, outside this stage's write set. Another P2 repair round would be refused the same way.
- **Decision.** Stop the pass as BLOCKED instead of looping. ADR-INV-018 stands: INV v1 declares no use of either interface. The P2 artifacts are complete and kept as written; only the decision records cite this ADR.
- **Unblock condition.** Reword the two P1 cells with no change of meaning, through a P1 repair or an authorised edit, then regenerate `_state/current-srs.md` and re-run `gov.py analyze` for P2:
  - D-23 → "Subscribe to their events through the given events module"
  - D-13 → "Server-side import through the given file module once the core publishes the read"
  No P2 file changes for the findings to clear. This ADR then becomes ACCEPTED (unblocked).
- **Consequences.** P2 does not pass its gate, and P3.1 does not start, until the unblock condition holds. DBF-INV-001 … 219, XM-INV-001 … 013 and the script are unchanged. The contract needs no change, because neither name appears in it.
- **Traces.** ADR-INV-018; SRS D-13, D-23; REQ-INV-043, REQ-INV-051, REQ-INV-052, REQ-INV-070, REQ-INV-071, REQ-INV-073.
- **Status.** ACCEPTED — resolved by ADR-INV-020 (raised BLOCKED in repair round 2, because the exit condition depended on a P1 artifact; the condition now holds).

#### ADR-INV-020 — The SRS D-13 and D-23 override cells name no given interface (C-GIVEN-2 cleared on the SRS side)
- **Context.** P2 was refused again with the same two C-GIVEN-2 findings on artifact `srs`. This repair round authorises an in-place edit of `P1/srs-inv.md` for them, which is the unblock condition of ADR-INV-019.
- **Decision.** Stop using the interfaces, as ADR-INV-018 decided. Reword the two "Override / status" cells with no change of meaning: D-13 → "Server-side import through the given file module once the core publishes the read"; D-23 → "Subscribe to their events through the given events module". The SRS and contract `given-usage` blocks are unchanged and stay identical.
- **Consequences.** No P1 file names either interface. The unblock condition of ADR-INV-019 holds, and ADR-INV-019 is ACCEPTED (resolved). No DBF, XM or SQL changes.
- **Traces.** ADR-INV-018, ADR-INV-019; SRS D-13, D-23; REQ-INV-043, REQ-INV-051, REQ-INV-052, REQ-INV-070, REQ-INV-071, REQ-INV-073.
- **Status.** ACCEPTED — non-breaking. Filed as `analysis/decisions/INV/ADR-INV-020.md`.

# Flow diagram — Inventory / المخزون (INV)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Module : INV   Version : v1   Stage : P3.2 Part A (UX design)   Profile : commerce
Inputs : srs-inv (PART B screen requirements, A4 REQ/AC), prd-inv (US priority), registry-srs
Screens: SCR-INV-001 … SCR-INV-012 (one per SCR-REQ-INV-001 … 012 — see ui-ux-spec-inv.md)
══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Every inventory screen reads the inventory context (active warehouse and branch counts, capability flags —
API-INV-008) on load. The menu and every flow below show a warehouse, branch, lot or measure step only when the
SRS lets it be shown (REQ-INV-010 … 012, REQ-INV-029, REQ-INV-030, REQ-INV-134, REQ-INV-135). Menu entries
follow the role grants (REQ-INV-136, REQ-INV-137). Priorities come from the PRD (INV-P11).

## Navigation map

| From | To | Seeded filter (identifies one record or one set) |
|---|---|---|
| Inventory menu | every SCR | — |
| SCR-INV-001 Warehouses (row) | SCR-INV-003 Stock balances | `warehousePk` |
| SCR-INV-002 Branches (row) | SCR-INV-001 Warehouses | `branchPk` |
| SCR-INV-003 Stock balances (row) | SCR-INV-004 Stock move history | `variantPk` + `warehousePk` (+ `lotPk` when the row has a lot) |
| SCR-INV-005 Transfers (posted entry) | SCR-INV-004 Stock move history | `sourceDocTypeCode=INV_TRANSFER` + `sourceDocRef=<transferPk>` (one document exactly — a number alone could match another module's document) |
| SCR-INV-006 Stock counts (posted entry) | SCR-INV-007 Stock adjustments | `adjustmentPk` of the count (entry route `/:id`) |
| SCR-INV-007 Stock adjustments (posted entry) | SCR-INV-004 Stock move history | `sourceDocTypeCode=INV_ADJUSTMENT` + `sourceDocRef=<stockAdjustmentPk>` (one document exactly) |
| SCR-INV-008 Lots (expired row) | SCR-INV-007 Stock adjustments (new) | `reason=EXPIRY_WRITE_OFF` + `lotPk` + `warehousePk` |
| SCR-INV-008 Lots (row) | SCR-INV-003 Stock balances | `lotPk` (+ `warehousePk`) |
| SCR-INV-010 Opening stock (after posting) | SCR-INV-007 Stock adjustments | `stockAdjustmentPk` of the posted OPENING_STOCK adjustment |
| SCR-INV-012 Stock valuation (row) | SCR-INV-004 Stock move history | `variantPk` |
| Near-expiry notification | SCR-INV-008 Lots | `nearExpiryOnly=true` |

in `api-spec-inv.yaml`. They are not restated here. All operations sit under the module base path

**Reconciliation against the SRS (once).**
- Every SRS B5 row of SCR-REQ-INV-001 … 012 has its operation in the document. The document adds API-INV-008
  (inventory context), which the SRS B5 of SCR-REQ-INV-001 lists. All 52 operations are bound to at least one
  screen action (operations coverage table, ALIGN-FE). No operation maps to no REQ.
- **Codes with no RULE.** These codes are routed with the catalogue text, by reference:
  - INV-400, INV-401, INV-403, INV-500, the `INV-404-*` not-found codes and INV-409-STALE-VERSION (ADR-INV-021,
    ADR-INV-032).
  - INV-422-HORIZON-RANGE: DEFAULT D-04; the text is that of AC-INV-133.
  - INV-422-LOAD-ROWS-INVALID: the wrapper of row failures; each `details[]` row carries its own code and text.
- **Reads that are not operations of the document** (ADR-INV-033):
  - CAT reads, as UXD-INV-001 … 011;
  - the session permissions, from the given `sec`.
  The INV_* lookup values are no longer such a read: INV serves its own six keys through API-INV-052 (`InvLookups`,
  ADR-INV-033 as amended at gate-analysis revise 2).
  None of them is a `read` hook.
- **Values absent from the document:** none. The warehouse label of balance rows and of availability rows is
  carried by the rows themselves (`warehouseCode`, `warehouseNameAr`, `warehouseNameEn` — ADR-INV-036).

**Shared conventions for all phases** (each SUB below assumes them):
- **Envelope.** Responses are unwrapped from `ApiResponse<T>.data` in one HTTP client. Errors are parsed as
  `ErrorResponse {code, messageAr, messageEn, details[]}`. Each catalogue text is shown in the user's language,
  from the response.
- **Generic error routing**, used wherever a SUB says "generic":
  - INV-400 → generic validation message;
  - INV-401 → login;
  - INV-403 → unauthorized view or message, text: catalogue INV-403 «ليست لديك صلاحية لهذا الإجراء.» /
    "You do not have permission for this action." (AC-INV-154);
  - INV-500 and network failures → generic retry message;
  - INV-409-STALE-VERSION → «reload» prompt with the catalogue text, which re-reads the record and keeps the
    user's unsaved input where it still applies;
  - `INV-404-*` → the catalogue text, and the drawer or route returns to the search.
- **Line refusals** (ADR-INV-046). A refusal raised by a rule on one line of a transfer, count or adjustment
  carries `details[0] {lineRef, lineRefKind, rowNo?, code, messageAr, messageEn}`. The line is found by
  `lineRefKind`: `LINE_PK` → the line with that identifier, `REQUEST_POSITION` → the n-th line the request sent;
  adjustment lines also carry `rowNo`. The code's text is placed on that line, its drawer opens on the field the code
  names, and the rest of the form is kept. With no `details`, the text goes to the lines pane.
- **Message binding.** In the F2 blocks, "text: RULE-INV-nnn message (SRS)" means the SRS A5 message of that RULE, in ar and en.
  It is the same text the server returns.
- **Filter state.** Filter objects carry `page` and `size` inside them. The filter object is the query key, and
  the URL search params mirror it, so a deep link restores the search.

## F1 — Models & Types

**RF1.** The field and DTO binding is `api-spec-inv.yaml`. TypeScript types are generated from
`components.schemas` of the document. They are not hand-written, and none is restated here. Each SUB names the
schemas its screen uses and the client-only types it adds: filter objects, form state and option shapes.
Shared client types live in the module's `types` folder:
- `Envelope<T>` and `Page<T>` from `ApiResponse` / `PageMeta`;
- `InvError` from `ErrorResponse`;
- `LookupOption {code, labelAr, labelEn}` for INV_* lookup keys and the CAT unit-of-measure key;
- `CatVariantRef {variantPk, itemPk, code, nameAr, nameEn}` and `CatItemRef {itemPk, code, nameAr, nameEn,
  itemKindCode}`, the shapes the CAT reads return to INV screens (UXD, ADR-INV-033);
- `InventoryContext` from the schema of the same name.
Quantities and measures are decimal strings in form state, with 3 places. Costs have 4 places and values have 2.
They are converted to numbers only at the request boundary, so rounding never happens in the browser
(DEFAULT D-06).

### F1 · SCR-INV-001 — Warehouses
- Schemas: `Warehouse`, `WarehouseCreateRequest`, `WarehouseUpdateRequest`, `WarehouseEnvelope`, `WarehousePageEnvelope`, `VersionedActionRequest`, `Branch` (labels), `InventoryContext`.
- `WarehouseFilter {code?, name?, branchPk?, active: 'ACTIVE_ONLY' | 'ALL', page, size}`. The default is `{active: 'ACTIVE_ONLY', page: 0, size: 20}`.
- `WarehouseFormState {nameAr, nameEn, branchPk | null, version?}`. `branchPk` is null for a new warehouse while the branch field is hidden. The server assigns the default branch (REQ-INV-031).
- `WarehouseEntryNav = 'new' | warehousePk`, which comes from the `entry` search param.

## F2 — Data Hooks

**RF2.** Each SUB declares what its screen needs from the API: one `screen-hooks` block, then a table that
explains each row. Server state lives in `tanstack-query`. Components call the screen's FACADE only. The facade
calls only the hooks declared for its screen. The default cache policy applies (staleTime 30 s, gcTime 5 min)
unless a row says otherwise. Loading is `LOCAL` everywhere. The SRS names no slow call, so no hook uses `GLOBAL`.

**Shared hooks.** Each key below has ONE hook, and every screen that uses the key shares it.

| Hook | Kind | Source | Cache key | Policy · notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| INV-CONTEXT | init | API-INV-008 | `['inv','context']` | staleTime 5 min; refetch on window focus. Every warehouse or branch create, deactivate or reactivate invalidates it, so a second warehouse or branch reveals its controls with no reload (REQ-INV-015, REQ-INV-032). Flags come from FeatureFlags through the server, never from the activity (REQ-INV-132) |
| SESSION-PERMISSIONS | init | authenticated session (given `sec`, ADR-INV-033) | — (session store) | the set of `PERM_INV_*` the user holds |
| WAREHOUSES-LOOKUP | lookup | API-INV-001 | `['inv','lookup','warehouses',{active,page:0,size:100}]` | staleTime 10 min. Selectors use `ACTIVE_ONLY`; labels use `ALL`, because history can show an inactive warehouse. An id not on the page is labelled through API-INV-002. Requires `PERM_INV_WAREHOUSES_VIEW`; without it the lookup does not run and no warehouse filter is offered — balance and availability rows carry their own label (ADR-INV-036). Options are `{warehousePk, code, nameAr, nameEn, isDefaultFl}` |
| BRANCHES-LOOKUP | lookup | API-INV-009 | `['inv','lookup','branches',{active,page:0,size:100}]` | staleTime 10 min. Selectors use `ACTIVE_ONLY`; labels use `ALL` |
| LOTS-LOOKUP | lookup | API-INV-040 | `['inv','lookup','lots',{variantPk,warehousePk,page:0,size:100}]` | scoped by its parent, the Variant (and the warehouse when one is chosen). Enabled only when `variantPk` is set, `lotExpiry` is on and the user holds `PERM_INV_LOTS_VIEW`. Options are `{lotPk, code, expiryDate, expiredFl, onHandQty}` |
| ITEM-TRACKING-LOOKUP | lookup | API-INV-044 | `['inv','item-settings',itemPk]` | `lotTrackedFl` / `dualQuantityFl` / `measureUomCode` of a line's Item, so the line knows whether to ask for a lot or a measure. An Item with no record answers false / false / empty (REQ-INV-129). Shared with the SCR-INV-009 entry |
| LOOKUP-INV_ADJUSTMENT_REASON, LOOKUP-INV_MOVE_TYPE, LOOKUP-INV_DOC_STATUS, LOOKUP-INV_SOURCE_DOC_TYPE | lookup | API-INV-052 (`InvLookups` — INV's own keys through `OwnedLookups`, ADR-INV-033) | `['inv','lookup-key',<key>]` | session-long cache. Options are `LookupOption {code, labelAr, labelEn}` mapped from `LookupValue {code, nameAr, nameEn, sortOrder}`, in sortOrder; open keys show the tenant's added values. INV-404-LOOKUP-KEY-UNKNOWN → the select shows no option, text: catalogue |
| CAT-VARIANT-LOOKUP | lookup | CAT (UXD-INV-001, 004, 005, 006, 007, 008, 011) | `['cat','variant-search',term]` · `['cat','barcode',barcode]` · `['cat','variant',variantPk]` | search by code or name (CON-CAT-016), barcode → Variant (CON-CAT-010), read Variant with its `itemPk` (CON-CAT-008). staleTime 5 min. An unknown barcode answers "not found" with no throw |
| CAT-ITEM-LOOKUP | lookup | CAT (UXD-INV-002, 009, 011) | `['cat','item-search',term]` · `['cat','item',itemPk]` | search (CON-CAT-016) and read Item (CON-CAT-007), with `itemKindCode` |
| CAT-UOM-LOOKUP | lookup | CAT unit-of-measure lookup (UXD-INV-003, 010) | `['cat','uom']` | session-long cache; labels `measureUomCode` in ar / en |

```yaml name=screen-hooks

hooks:
  - {hook: WAREHOUSES-SCREEN-INIT, kind: init, api: [API-INV-008], cache_key: "['inv','context']", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}

  - {hook: WAREHOUSE-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-INV-002], cache_key: "['inv','warehouse',warehousePk]", errors: "INV-404-WAREHOUSE-NOT-FOUND → message, drawer closes", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: BRANCHES-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, api: [API-INV-009], cache_key: "['inv','lookup','branches',{active}]", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: WAREHOUSE-CREATE, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-003], errors: "NAME-TAKEN → inline nameAr; BRANCH-INACTIVE / BRANCH-NOT-FOUND → inline branchPk", invalidation: "['inv','warehouses'], ['inv','lookup','warehouses'], ['inv','context']"}
  - {hook: WAREHOUSE-UPDATE, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-004], errors: "NAME-TAKEN → inline nameAr; BRANCH-INACTIVE → inline branchPk; STALE-VERSION → reload", invalidation: "['inv','warehouses'], ['inv','warehouse',id], ['inv','lookup','warehouses']"}
  - {hook: WAREHOUSE-DEACTIVATE, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-005], errors: "WAREHOUSE-DEFAULT / WAREHOUSE-IN-USE → message", invalidation: "['inv','warehouses'], ['inv','warehouse',id], ['inv','lookup','warehouses'], ['inv','context']"}
  - {hook: WAREHOUSE-REACTIVATE, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-006], errors: "BRANCH-INACTIVE → message; STALE-VERSION → reload", invalidation: "['inv','warehouses'], ['inv','warehouse',id], ['inv','lookup','warehouses'], ['inv','context']"}
  - {hook: WAREHOUSE-SET-DEFAULT, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-007], errors: "WAREHOUSE-DEFAULT-INACTIVE → message; STALE-VERSION → reload", invalidation: "['inv','warehouses'], ['inv','lookup','warehouses'], ['inv','context']"}

```

| Hook | Role · cache · errors (code → routing, text) |
|---|---|
| WAREHOUSES-SCREEN-INIT | Permission read: VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE of `INV_WAREHOUSES`. Context: `activeBranchCount`; while it is 1, the branch filter, column and field are hidden (REQ-INV-029, REQ-INV-030). Lookups: BRANCHES-LOOKUP when more than one branch is active. Entity by id: WAREHOUSE-QUERY when `entry=<id>` |
| WAREHOUSES-QUERY | read. Ordered by code on the server (REQ-INV-009). Key = the full filter |
| WAREHOUSE-QUERY | read, enabled only while the entry drawer is open on an id |
| WAREHOUSE-CREATE | mutation; body `{nameAr, nameEn, branchPk | null}`. INV-409-WAREHOUSE-NAME-TAKEN → inline on nameAr, text: RULE-INV-002 message (SRS) · INV-422-BRANCH-INACTIVE → inline on branchPk, text: RULE-INV-009 message (SRS) · INV-404-BRANCH-NOT-FOUND → inline on branchPk, text: catalogue · generic. On success the drawer closes and the search refetches |
| WAREHOUSE-UPDATE | mutation; body `{nameAr, nameEn, branchPk, version}`. `code` is never sent, and a hidden branch sends the record's `branchPk`. INV-409-WAREHOUSE-NAME-TAKEN → inline on nameAr, text: RULE-INV-002 message (SRS) · INV-422-BRANCH-INACTIVE → inline on branchPk, text: RULE-INV-009 message (SRS) · INV-422-WAREHOUSE-CODE-READONLY → message, text: RULE-INV-001 message (SRS) · INV-409-STALE-VERSION → reload · generic |
| WAREHOUSE-DEACTIVATE | mutation (DELETE, no body), after a confirmation. INV-409-WAREHOUSE-DEFAULT → message, text: RULE-INV-003 message (SRS), with the next action "Set as default" on another row · INV-409-WAREHOUSE-IN-USE → message, text: RULE-INV-004 message (SRS), with the next action "View balances", which opens SCR-INV-003 seeded with `warehousePk` |
| WAREHOUSE-REACTIVATE | mutation `{version}`. INV-422-BRANCH-INACTIVE → message, text: RULE-INV-009 message (SRS) · INV-409-STALE-VERSION → reload |
| WAREHOUSE-SET-DEFAULT | mutation `{version}` of the target. INV-409-WAREHOUSE-DEFAULT-INACTIVE → message, text: RULE-INV-006 message (SRS) · INV-409-STALE-VERSION → reload |
| WAREHOUSES-FACADE | Owns the list from query data, the filter `{code,name,branchPk,active,page,size}` mirrored to the URL, the entry navigation `entry`, the form's dirty state and derived loading. Operations: `save()` (create or update), `deactivate(id)`, `reactivate(id, version)`, `setDefault(id, version)`, `openEntry(id | 'new')`, `closeEntry()` |

### F2 · SCR-INV-003 — Stock balances

```yaml name=screen-hooks
screen: SCR-INV-003
hooks:
  - {hook: BALANCES-SCREEN-INIT, kind: init, api: [API-INV-008], cache_key: "['inv','context']", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: BALANCES-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-INV-016], cache_key: "['inv','stock-balances',filter{variantPk,term,itemPk,warehousePk,lotPk,nonZero,page,size}]", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: AVAILABILITY-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-INV-017], cache_key: "['inv','availability',variantPk,warehousePk]", errors: "BUNDLE-NO-COMPONENTS → summary message; VARIANT-NOT-FOUND / WAREHOUSE-NOT-FOUND → summary message", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: WAREHOUSES-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, api: [API-INV-001], cache_key: "['inv','lookup','warehouses',{active}]", errors: "INV-403 → warehouse filter not offered (labels come from the rows)", loading: LOCAL}
  - {hook: LOTS-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, api: [API-INV-040], cache_key: "['inv','lookup','lots',{variantPk,warehousePk}]", errors: "INV-403 → lot filter not offered", loading: LOCAL}
  - {hook: CAT-VARIANT-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "['cat','variant-search',term] · ['cat','barcode',barcode]", errors: "not found → 'no results' in the picker", loading: LOCAL}
  - {hook: CAT-ITEM-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "['cat','item-search',term] · ['cat','item',itemPk]", errors: "not found → name left empty", loading: LOCAL}
  - {hook: CAT-UOM-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "['cat','uom']", errors: "unknown code → the code is shown", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: BALANCES-FACADE, kind: facade}
```

| Hook | Role · cache · errors (code → routing, text) |
|---|---|
| BALANCES-SCREEN-INIT | Permission read: `PERM_INV_STOCK_BALANCES_VIEW`, plus `PERM_INV_WAREHOUSES_VIEW` and `PERM_INV_LOTS_VIEW` to decide whether the warehouse and lot filter lookups run (ADR-INV-036 — labels never depend on them). Context: `activeWarehouseCount` (filter and column hidden while it is 1 — REQ-INV-012), `lotExpiryFl` (lot filter and columns), `dualQuantityFl` (measure column — REQ-INV-135) |
| BALANCES-QUERY | read. Each row carries the Variant code and name, the warehouse code and names (the warehouse column's label for every role — ADR-INV-036), lot code, expiry, expired mark (REQ-INV-115), on-hand, reserved and available (REQ-INV-038, REQ-INV-113) and the measure. A Variant with no record answers zeros (REQ-INV-041) and the screen shows them as such |
| AVAILABILITY-QUERY | read, enabled only when the filter names one Variant. It shows per-warehouse rows (labelled from their `warehouseCode` / names) and total availability (REQ-INV-040); for a bundle Variant this is the derived availability (REQ-INV-042). INV-422-BUNDLE-NO-COMPONENTS → message in the summary, text: RULE-INV-022 message (SRS) · `INV-404-*` → summary message, text: catalogue |
| WAREHOUSES-LOOKUP | fills the warehouse filter only (the rows label themselves). Without `PERM_INV_WAREHOUSES_VIEW` it does not run and the filter is not offered (ADR-INV-036) |
| LOTS-LOOKUP | lot filter options, scoped by the chosen Variant; run only with `PERM_INV_LOTS_VIEW` |
| CAT-VARIANT-LOOKUP | UXD-INV-001: the Variant filter. Choosing a Variant sets `variantPk`. A scanned barcode goes to `term` unchanged |
| CAT-ITEM-LOOKUP | UXD-INV-002: the Item filter sets `itemPk`. The Item name column reads `['cat','variant',variantPk]` → `itemPk` → `['cat','item',itemPk]`, deduplicated per page |
| CAT-UOM-LOOKUP | UXD-INV-003: labels `measureUomCode` beside the measure (REQ-INV-121) |
| BALANCES-FACADE | Owns the rows from query data, the filter (with page and size) mirrored to the URL, the summary data and derived loading. Operations: `setFilter`, `openMoves(row)`, which navigates to SCR-INV-004 with `variantPk`, `warehousePk` and `lotPk`. No mutation |
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-INV-003:END -->

Flags `lotExpiryFl`, `dualQuantityFl`. Entity by id: TRANSFER-QUERY on `/:id` |
| TRANSFERS-QUERY | read, newest first (REQ-INV-086) |
| TRANSFER-CREATE | mutation `{docDate, fromWarehousePk, toWarehousePk, noteText, lines[]}`; each line is `{variantPk, lotPk, quantity, measureQty}`. INV-422-TRANSFER-WAREHOUSES → inline on toWarehousePk, text: RULE-INV-016 message (SRS) · INV-422-QUANTITY-INVALID → line quantity, text: RULE-INV-017 message (SRS) · INV-422-VARIANT-INACTIVE → line Variant, text: RULE-INV-018 message (SRS) · INV-422-LOT-REQUIRED → line lot, text: RULE-INV-037 message (SRS) · INV-422-MEASURE-REQUIRED → line measure, text: RULE-INV-040 message (SRS) · INV-422-DUPLICATE-LINE → line Variant, text: RULE-INV-048 message (SRS) · `INV-404-WAREHOUSE / VARIANT / LOT-NOT-FOUND` → field or line, text: catalogue. INV-422-DOC-DATE-FUTURE → inline on docDate, text: RULE-INV-051 message (SRS). A line code is placed on the line `details[0]` names — `REQUEST_POSITION` n is the n-th line of the request, `LINE_PK` the line with that `transferLinePk` (ADR-INV-046) — and the line drawer opens on it; with no `details`, in the lines pane. On success the route becomes `/:id` |
| TRANSFER-UPDATE | mutation: the create body plus `{version}`, with each line keeping its `transferLinePk`; it replaces header and lines (REQ-INV-079). The create routing applies, plus INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → message, text: RULE-INV-029 message (SRS), and the entry reloads read-only · INV-422-DOC-NO-READONLY → message, text: RULE-INV-030 message (SRS) · INV-409-STALE-VERSION → reload |
| TRANSFER-POST | mutation `{version}`; offered only on a saved, unchanged DRAFT. INV-422-NO-LINES → message, text: RULE-INV-031 message (SRS) · INV-409-NEGATIVE-STOCK → message, text: RULE-INV-019 message (SRS) (the server text carries the on-hand) · INV-422-TRANSFER-WAREHOUSES → message, text: RULE-INV-016 message (SRS) (a warehouse was deactivated since the save) · INV-422-VARIANT-INACTIVE → the line, text: RULE-INV-018 message (SRS) · INV-422-LOT-REQUIRED → the line's lot, text: RULE-INV-037 message (SRS) · INV-422-MEASURE-REQUIRED → the line's measure, text: RULE-INV-040 message (SRS) (the Variant or its Item stock settings changed since the save — ADR-INV-045; the user edits the line, saves, then posts) · INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → message, text: RULE-INV-029 message (SRS) · INV-409-STALE-VERSION → reload. Every line code is placed on the line `details[0].lineRef` names (`LINE_PK` = transferLinePk — ADR-INV-046), and the line is highlighted in the pane |
| TRANSFER-CANCEL | mutation (DELETE), after a confirmation. INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → message, text: RULE-INV-029 message (SRS) |
| WAREHOUSES-LOOKUP | from / to selectors use `ACTIVE_ONLY`; labels use `ALL` |
| LOTS-LOOKUP | line lot options, scoped by the line's Variant and the header's from-warehouse (REQ-INV-084); expired lots are marked. A saved line shows its own `lotCode`, never a lookup label. The options always add «بدون تشغيلة» / "Without a lot" for a lot-tracked line; the server accepts it only up to the Variant's stock held without a lot in the from-warehouse and otherwise answers INV-422-LOT-REQUIRED on the line (REQ-INV-139) |
| ITEM-TRACKING-LOOKUP | per line Item. It decides whether the line asks for a lot (lotExpiry on and `lotTrackedFl`) and a measure (dualQuantity on and `dualQuantityFl`, REQ-INV-122) |
| CAT-VARIANT-LOOKUP / CAT-UOM-LOOKUP | UXD-INV-005: barcode → Variant, pick by code or name, label of each saved line's `variantPk`, the line Item's `itemPk`, and the measure unit label |
| TRANSFERS-FACADE | Owns the list and filter, the form state (header and lines), the `line` navigation param, `isDirty`, the derived `isReadOnly` (status ≠ DRAFT) and derived loading. Operations: `save()` (create or update, ONE call), `post()` and `cancel()` (enabled only when the form is clean and DRAFT), `addLine(draft)` and `replaceLine(key, draft)` (form state only), `removeLine(key)` |
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-INV-005:END -->

### F2 · SCR-INV-006 — Stock counts

```yaml name=screen-hooks
screen: SCR-INV-006
hooks:
  - {hook: COUNTS-SCREEN-INIT, kind: init, api: [API-INV-008], cache_key: "['inv','context']", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: COUNTS-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-INV-026], cache_key: "['inv','stock-counts',filter{docNo,dateFrom,dateTo,warehousePk,statusCode,page,size}]", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: COUNT-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-INV-027], cache_key: "['inv','stock-count',stockCountPk]", errors: "INV-404-STOCK-COUNT-NOT-FOUND → message, back to search", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: COUNT-START, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-028], errors: "WAREHOUSE-REQUIRED / WAREHOUSE-INACTIVE → inline warehousePk", invalidation: "['inv','stock-counts']"}
  - {hook: COUNT-LINE-ADD, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-029], errors: "BARCODE-UNKNOWN → inline barcode + pick by hand; COUNTED-NEGATIVE → inline countedQty; LOT-REQUIRED / MEASURE-REQUIRED → line drawer; DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only", invalidation: "['inv','stock-count',id]"}
  - {hook: COUNT-LINE-CHANGE, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-030], errors: "COUNTED-NEGATIVE / MEASURE-REQUIRED → inline in the line drawer; STALE-VERSION → reload", invalidation: "['inv','stock-count',id]"}
  - {hook: COUNT-LINE-REMOVE, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-031], errors: "DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only", invalidation: "['inv','stock-count',id]"}
  - {hook: COUNT-POST, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-032], errors: "NO-LINES / NEGATIVE-STOCK / WAREHOUSE-INACTIVE → message; VARIANT-INACTIVE / LOT-REQUIRED / MEASURE-REQUIRED → the line card; STALE-VERSION → reload", invalidation: "['inv','stock-counts'], ['inv','stock-count',id], ['inv','stock-adjustments'], ['inv','stock-balances'], ['inv','availability'], ['inv','stock-moves'], ['inv','valuation']"}
  - {hook: COUNT-CANCEL, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-033], errors: "DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only", invalidation: "['inv','stock-counts'], ['inv','stock-count',id]"}
  - {hook: WAREHOUSES-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, api: [API-INV-001], cache_key: "['inv','lookup','warehouses',{active}]", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL}
  - {hook: LOTS-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, api: [API-INV-040], cache_key: "['inv','lookup','lots',{variantPk,warehousePk}]", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL}
  - {hook: ITEM-TRACKING-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, api: [API-INV-044], cache_key: "['inv','item-settings',itemPk]", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL}
  - {hook: LOOKUP-INV_DOC_STATUS, kind: lookup, api: [API-INV-052], cache_key: "['inv','lookup-key','INV_DOC_STATUS']", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: CAT-VARIANT-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "['cat','barcode',barcode] · ['cat','variant-search',term] · ['cat','variant',variantPk]", errors: "not found → RULE-INV-032 text inline on barcode", loading: LOCAL}
  - {hook: CAT-UOM-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "['cat','uom']", loading: NONE}
  - {hook: COUNTS-FACADE, kind: facade}
```

| Hook | Role · cache · errors (code → routing, text) |
|---|---|
| COUNTS-SCREEN-INIT | Permission read: VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE of `INV_COUNTS`. Context: `activeWarehouseCount`. While it is 1, "Start count" sends no warehouse and the server applies the default (REQ-INV-013); otherwise `/new` asks for it. Flags. Entity by id: COUNT-QUERY on `/:id` |
| COUNTS-QUERY | read, newest first (REQ-INV-095) |
| COUNT-START | mutation `{warehousePk | null, docDate, noteText}`. INV-422-DOC-DATE-FUTURE → inline on docDate, text: RULE-INV-051 message (SRS) · INV-422-WAREHOUSE-REQUIRED → inline on warehousePk, text: RULE-INV-008 message (SRS) · INV-422-WAREHOUSE-INACTIVE → inline on warehousePk, text: RULE-INV-007 message (SRS) · INV-404-WAREHOUSE-NOT-FOUND → inline, text: catalogue. On success the route becomes `/:id` |
| COUNT-LINE-ADD | mutation `{barcode | variantPk, countedQty, lotPk, countedMeasureQty}`, ONE call per scan (ADR-INV-034). The server adds to an existing line (REQ-INV-088). INV-422-BARCODE-UNKNOWN → inline on barcode, text: RULE-INV-032 message (SRS), and the Variant picker is offered (REQ-INV-091) · INV-422-VARIANT-INACTIVE → inline on barcode, text: RULE-INV-018 message (SRS) · INV-422-COUNTED-NEGATIVE → inline on countedQty, text: RULE-INV-047 message (SRS) · INV-422-LOT-REQUIRED → the line drawer opens at lot, text: RULE-INV-037 message (SRS) · INV-422-MEASURE-REQUIRED → the line drawer opens at measure, text: RULE-INV-040 message (SRS) · INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → message, text: RULE-INV-029 message (SRS), and the entry reloads read-only (REQ-INV-096) · `INV-404-*` → catalogue |
| COUNT-LINE-CHANGE | mutation `{countedQty, countedMeasureQty, version}` from the one-line drawer. INV-422-COUNTED-NEGATIVE → inline, text: RULE-INV-047 message (SRS) · INV-422-MEASURE-REQUIRED → inline, text: RULE-INV-040 message (SRS) · INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only, text: RULE-INV-029 message (SRS) · INV-409-STALE-VERSION → reload |
| COUNT-LINE-REMOVE | mutation (DELETE line), after a confirmation in the drawer. INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only, text: RULE-INV-029 message (SRS) |
| COUNT-POST | mutation `{version}`, after a confirmation. The answer carries the count and the resulting adjustment (or null when every difference is zero). INV-422-NO-LINES → message, text: RULE-INV-031 message (SRS) · INV-409-NEGATIVE-STOCK → message, text: RULE-INV-019 message (SRS) · INV-422-WAREHOUSE-INACTIVE → message, text: RULE-INV-007 message (SRS) · INV-422-VARIANT-INACTIVE → the line card, text: RULE-INV-018 message (SRS) · INV-422-LOT-REQUIRED → the line drawer at lot, text: RULE-INV-037 message (SRS) · INV-422-MEASURE-REQUIRED → the line drawer at measure, text: RULE-INV-040 message (SRS) (re-checked on post — ADR-INV-045) — each line code opens the line card whose `stockCountLinePk` is `details[0].lineRef` (ADR-INV-046) · INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only · INV-409-STALE-VERSION → reload. A count never answers INV-422-NO-KNOWN-COST (an increase of a never-valued Variant enters at cost 0 — ADR-INV-030), INV-422-LOT-EXPIRY-REQUIRED or INV-422-LOT-EXPIRY-MISMATCH (a found quantity enters under the counted lot — REQ-INV-092). On success the entry shows systemQty and differenceQty and, on a dual-quantity line, the system measure (`systemMeasureQty`, derived — ADR-INV-054), plus a link to the adjustment |
| COUNT-CANCEL | mutation (DELETE), after a confirmation. INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only, text: RULE-INV-029 message (SRS) |
| WAREHOUSES-LOOKUP / LOTS-LOOKUP / ITEM-TRACKING-LOOKUP | the warehouse selector at start; lot options scoped by the scanned Variant and the count's warehouse, plus «بدون تشغيلة» / "Without a lot" (REQ-INV-139 — the server refuses a counted quantity above the lot-less stock with INV-422-LOT-REQUIRED); whether a lot or measure must be asked before the line call is sent. Line cards show each line's `lotCode`, and the posted count links its adjustment by `adjustmentDocNo` |
| CAT-VARIANT-LOOKUP / CAT-UOM-LOOKUP | UXD-INV-006. A scanned barcode is resolved first, to get `itemPk` → ITEM-TRACKING-LOOKUP. For an Item with no lot or measure, the scan is sent at once with `barcode`. Otherwise the line drawer asks for the lot or measure and sends `variantPk`. The hooks also pick a Variant by hand after an unknown barcode, and label each line's `variantPk` |
| COUNTS-FACADE | Owns the list and filter, the scan state, the `line` navigation param (a `stockCountLinePk`), derived `isReadOnly` and derived loading. The lines shown are COUNT-QUERY data, never a local copy. Operations: `start()`, `scan(barcode, qty)`, `addPicked(variant, qty, lot, measure)`, `changeLine(lineId, …)`, `removeLine(lineId)`, `post()`, `cancel()` |
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-INV-006:END -->

### F2 · SCR-INV-007 — Stock adjustments

```yaml name=screen-hooks
screen: SCR-INV-007
hooks:
  - {hook: ADJUSTMENTS-SCREEN-INIT, kind: init, api: [API-INV-008], cache_key: "['inv','context']", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: ADJUSTMENTS-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-INV-034], cache_key: "['inv','stock-adjustments',filter{docNo,dateFrom,dateTo,warehousePk,reasonCode,statusCode,page,size}]", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: ADJUSTMENT-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-INV-035], cache_key: "['inv','stock-adjustment',stockAdjustmentPk]", errors: "INV-404-STOCK-ADJUSTMENT-NOT-FOUND → message, back to search", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: WRITE-OFF-LOT-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-INV-041], cache_key: "['inv','lot',lotPk]", errors: "INV-404-LOT-NOT-FOUND → message, no seeded line", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: WRITE-OFF-BALANCE-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-INV-016], cache_key: "['inv','stock-balances',{lotPk,warehousePk,nonZero:true,page:0,size:1}]", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: ADJUSTMENT-CREATE, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-036], errors: "REASON-REQUIRED → inline reasonCode; WAREHOUSE-* → inline warehousePk; line codes → the line", invalidation: "['inv','stock-adjustments']"}
  - {hook: ADJUSTMENT-UPDATE, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-037], errors: "DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only; STALE-VERSION → reload; line codes → the line", invalidation: "['inv','stock-adjustments'], ['inv','stock-adjustment',id]"}
  - {hook: ADJUSTMENT-POST, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-038], errors: "NEGATIVE-STOCK / NO-LINES / WAREHOUSE-INACTIVE → message; VARIANT-INACTIVE, cost and lot codes → the line; STALE-VERSION → reload", invalidation: "['inv','stock-adjustments'], ['inv','stock-adjustment',id], ['inv','stock-balances'], ['inv','availability'], ['inv','stock-moves'], ['inv','valuation'], ['inv','lookup','lots'], ['inv','lots']"}
  - {hook: ADJUSTMENT-CANCEL, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-039], errors: "DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only", invalidation: "['inv','stock-adjustments'], ['inv','stock-adjustment',id]"}
```

| Hook | Role · cache · errors (code → routing, text) |
|---|---|
| ADJUSTMENTS-SCREEN-INIT | Permission read: VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE / DELETE of `INV_ADJUSTMENTS`. Context: `activeWarehouseCount`; while it is 1 there is no warehouse field and `warehousePk` is sent null (REQ-INV-010, REQ-INV-013, AC-INV-013). Flags: lot columns hidden with lotExpiry off (AC-INV-150), measure with dualQuantity off. Lookups: reason, status. Entity by id: ADJUSTMENT-QUERY on `/:id`. Seed: WRITE-OFF-* on `/new?reason=EXPIRY_WRITE_OFF&lotPk&warehousePk` |
| ADJUSTMENTS-QUERY | read, newest first (REQ-INV-104) |
| WRITE-OFF-LOT-QUERY | read of the seeded lot (code, `variantPk`, expiry), so the seeded line gets `variantPk` and `lotNo = code` |
| WRITE-OFF-BALANCE-QUERY | read of the one balance row identified by `lotPk` + `warehousePk`. The seeded line gets `quantityChange = −onHandQty` (AC-INV-128); with no row, no line is seeded |
| ADJUSTMENT-CREATE | mutation `{warehousePk | null, docDate, reasonCode, noteText, lines[]}`; each line is `{rowNo, variantPk, lotNo, lotExpiryDate, quantityChange, measureQtyChange, unitCost}`. INV-422-REASON-REQUIRED → inline on reasonCode, text: RULE-INV-033 message (SRS) (also OPENING_STOCK sent by hand — ADR-INV-047) · INV-422-DOC-DATE-FUTURE → inline on docDate, text: RULE-INV-051 message (SRS) · INV-422-WAREHOUSE-REQUIRED → inline on warehousePk, text: RULE-INV-008 message (SRS) · INV-422-WAREHOUSE-INACTIVE → inline, text: RULE-INV-007 message (SRS) · INV-422-VARIANT-INACTIVE → line, text: RULE-INV-018 message (SRS) · INV-422-QUANTITY-INVALID → line quantityChange or measureQtyChange, text: RULE-INV-017 message (SRS) · INV-422-NO-KNOWN-COST → line unitCost (more than 4 decimals), text: RULE-INV-025 message (SRS) · INV-422-ZERO-CHANGE → line quantityChange, text: RULE-INV-034 message (SRS) · INV-422-MEASURE-REQUIRED → line measureQtyChange, text: RULE-INV-040 message (SRS) (a non-zero quantityChange of a dual-quantity Item) · INV-422-LOT-REQUIRED → line lot, text: RULE-INV-037 message (SRS) · INV-422-DUPLICATE-LINE → line, text: RULE-INV-048 message (SRS) · `INV-404-*` → catalogue. A line code goes to the line whose `rowNo` equals `details[0].rowNo` (ADR-INV-046) |
| ADJUSTMENT-UPDATE | mutation `{reasonCode, noteText, version, lines[]}`; it replaces reason, note and lines (REQ-INV-098). The create routing applies, plus INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only, text: RULE-INV-029 message (SRS) · INV-422-DOC-NO-READONLY → message, text: RULE-INV-030 message (SRS) · INV-409-STALE-VERSION → reload |
| ADJUSTMENT-POST | mutation `{version}`; offered only on a saved, unchanged DRAFT. INV-422-NO-LINES → message, text: RULE-INV-031 message (SRS) · INV-409-NEGATIVE-STOCK → message, text: RULE-INV-019 message (SRS) (REQ-INV-067) · INV-422-WAREHOUSE-INACTIVE → message, text: RULE-INV-007 message (SRS) · INV-422-VARIANT-INACTIVE → the line, text: RULE-INV-018 message (SRS) (both re-checked on post — ADR-INV-045) · INV-422-NO-KNOWN-COST → the line's unitCost, Advanced opened, text: RULE-INV-025 message (SRS) (REQ-INV-064, REQ-INV-102) · INV-422-OPENING-COST-REQUIRED → the line's unitCost, text: RULE-INV-026 message (SRS) · INV-422-LOT-EXPIRY-REQUIRED → the line's lot number and expiry, text: RULE-INV-035 message (SRS) (REQ-INV-105) · INV-422-LOT-EXPIRY-MISMATCH → the line's expiry, text: RULE-INV-036 message (SRS) (REQ-INV-107) · INV-422-LOT-REQUIRED → the line's lot, text: RULE-INV-037 message (SRS) · INV-422-MEASURE-REQUIRED → the line's measureQtyChange, text: RULE-INV-040 message (SRS) · INV-422-REASON-REQUIRED / INV-422-ZERO-CHANGE → as on create · INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only · INV-409-STALE-VERSION → reload. Each line code goes to the line whose `rowNo` is `details[0].rowNo` (ADR-INV-046) |
| ADJUSTMENT-CANCEL | mutation (DELETE), after a confirmation. INV-409-DOCUMENT-CLOSED → read-only, text: RULE-INV-029 message (SRS) |
| LOTS-LOOKUP | for a decrease line of a lot-tracked Item: lot options scoped by the line's Variant and the header's warehouse, plus «بدون تشغيلة» / "Without a lot" (REQ-INV-139), which leaves `lotNo` empty; choosing a lot sets `lotNo = code`. A saved line shows its `lotCode`; a count-generated adjustment shows its source count as `sourceCountDocNo`. For an increase line: when the typed `lotNo` matches an option, its expiry is prefilled (REQ-INV-106) |
| ITEM-TRACKING-LOOKUP | per line Item: whether lot and expiry, or a measure change, are asked (REQ-INV-123: a measure-only line is allowed for a dual-quantity Item) |
| CAT-VARIANT-LOOKUP / CAT-UOM-LOOKUP | UXD-INV-007: barcode → Variant, pick, label of each saved line's `variantPk`, the line Item, the measure unit label |
| ADJUSTMENTS-FACADE | Owns the list and filter, form state (header and lines, with `rowNo` kept in line order), the `line` navigation param, `isDirty`, `isReadOnly`, the line value total (posted documents) and derived loading. Operations: `save()` (ONE call), `post()`, `cancel()`, `addLine`, `replaceLine`, `removeLine` (form state only) |

### F2 · SCR-INV-008 — Lots and near expiry

```yaml name=screen-hooks
screen: SCR-INV-008
hooks:
  - {hook: LOTS-SCREEN-INIT, kind: init, api: [API-INV-008], cache_key: "['inv','context']", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}

  - {hook: LOT-CORRECT, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-042], errors: "STALE-VERSION → reload; INV-404-LOT-NOT-FOUND → message", invalidation: "['inv','lots'], ['inv','lot',id], ['inv','lookup','lots'], ['inv','stock-balances'], ['inv','availability']"}
```

```yaml name=screen-hooks

hooks:

  - {hook: ITEM-TRACKING-LOOKUP, kind: read, api: [API-INV-044], cache_key: "['inv','item-settings',itemPk]", errors: "INV-404-ITEM-NOT-FOUND → message, drawer closes", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: ITEM-SETTINGS-SAVE, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-045], errors: "LOT-TRACKING-IN-USE / DUAL-QUANTITY-IN-USE / BUNDLE-SETTINGS / MEASURE-UNIT-REQUIRED → inline; CAPABILITY-OFF → message; STALE-VERSION → reload", invalidation: "['inv','item-settings-search'], ['inv','item-settings',itemPk]"}
  - {hook: CAT-ITEM-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, cache_key: "['cat','item-search',term] · ['cat','item',itemPk]", errors: "not found → 'no results'", loading: LOCAL}
```

| Hook | Role · cache · errors (code → routing, text) |
|---|---|
| ITEM-SETTINGS-SCREEN-INIT | Permission read: VIEW / CREATE / UPDATE of `INV_ITEM_STOCK_SETTINGS`. Context: `lotExpiryFl`, `dualQuantityFl`. With both off the screen is not reachable; each control shows only with its flag (REQ-INV-134, REQ-INV-135). Entity by id: ITEM-TRACKING-LOOKUP on `entry=<itemPk>` |
| ITEM-SETTINGS-SEARCH-QUERY | read. Rows carry the Item's code and names from the INV answer |
| ITEM-TRACKING-LOOKUP | read of one Item's settings for the entry (REQ-INV-129); the same shared key the line drawers use |
| ITEM-SETTINGS-SAVE | mutation `{lotTrackedFl, dualQuantityFl, measureUomCode, version | null}`; idempotent create-or-update (ADR-INV-029). INV-409-LOT-TRACKING-IN-USE → inline on lotTrackedFl, text: RULE-INV-042 message (SRS) (the server text carries the count) · INV-409-DUAL-QUANTITY-IN-USE → inline on dualQuantityFl, text: RULE-INV-043 message (SRS) · INV-422-BUNDLE-SETTINGS → inline on the Item, text: RULE-INV-045 message (SRS) · INV-422-MEASURE-UNIT-REQUIRED → inline on measureUomCode, text: RULE-INV-041 message (SRS) · INV-422-CAPABILITY-OFF → message, text: RULE-INV-044 message (SRS) (the catalogue text) · INV-409-STALE-VERSION → reload · INV-404-ITEM-NOT-FOUND → catalogue |
| CAT-ITEM-LOOKUP | UXD-INV-009: the Item pick of a new record. A BUNDLE Item is shown with its kind; the server refuses it (RULE-INV-045) |
| CAT-UOM-LOOKUP | UXD-INV-010: measureUomCode options and labels |
| ITEM-SETTINGS-FACADE | Owns the rows, the filter with page and size, the `entry` param, form state and derived loading. Operations: `save()`, `openEntry(itemPk | 'new')`, `closeEntry()` |

### F2 · SCR-INV-010 — Opening stock

```yaml name=screen-hooks
screen: SCR-INV-010
hooks:
  - {hook: OPENING-SCREEN-INIT, kind: init, api: [API-INV-008], cache_key: "['inv','context']", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: OPENING-SHEET-QUERY, kind: read, api: [API-INV-046], cache_key: "none — imperative file download", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL, invalidation: "—"}
  - {hook: OPENING-STOCK-POST, kind: mutation, api: [API-INV-047], errors: "LOAD-ROWS-INVALID → row failures list by rowNo; LOAD-ROWS → message; WAREHOUSE-* → inline warehousePk; IDEMPOTENCY-KEY-REUSED → message + new key", invalidation: "['inv','stock-adjustments'], ['inv','stock-balances'], ['inv','availability'], ['inv','stock-moves'], ['inv','valuation'], ['inv','lookup','lots'], ['inv','lots']"}
  - {hook: WAREHOUSES-LOOKUP, kind: lookup, api: [API-INV-001], cache_key: "['inv','lookup','warehouses',{active:'ACTIVE_ONLY'}]", errors: "generic", loading: LOCAL}
  - {hook: OPENING-FACADE, kind: facade}
```

| Hook | Role · cache · errors (code → routing, text) |
|---|---|
| OPENING-SCREEN-INIT | Permission read: `PERM_INV_OPENING_STOCK_VIEW`, `_CREATE`. Context: warehouse count (selector hidden while 1); `lotExpiryFl` and `dualQuantityFl` decide the lot, expiry and measure columns (AC-INV-080) |
| OPENING-SHEET-QUERY | read of the xlsx file (REQ-INV-073), started by "Download sheet"; it saves the blob under the catalogue file name. Not cached |
| OPENING-STOCK-POST | mutation `{idempotencyKey, warehousePk | null, docDate, rows[]}` — the form's key, the same on every retry of the load, so a double click or a retry after a timeout posts once and answers the first adjustment (ADR-INV-053). INV-409-IDEMPOTENCY-KEY-REUSED → message, text: RULE-INV-050 message (SRS), and the form takes a new key (the key was used by another load); the rows are kept; each row is `{rowNo, barcode, variantPk: null, quantity, unitCost, lotNo, lotExpiryDate, measureQty}`, all in ONE call (ADR-INV-027, ADR-INV-035). INV-422-LOAD-ROWS-INVALID → the row failures list: each `details[]` entry is placed on the row with its `rowNo` and its own code's text. Those codes are INV-422-LOAD-ROW-VARIANT (RULE-INV-028), INV-422-QUANTITY-INVALID (RULE-INV-017), INV-422-NO-KNOWN-COST (RULE-INV-025, a cost with more than 4 decimals), INV-422-OPENING-COST-REQUIRED (RULE-INV-026), INV-422-VARIANT-INACTIVE (RULE-INV-018), INV-422-LOT-EXPIRY-REQUIRED (RULE-INV-035), INV-422-LOT-EXPIRY-MISMATCH (RULE-INV-036), INV-422-MEASURE-REQUIRED (RULE-INV-040), INV-422-DUPLICATE-LINE (RULE-INV-048), and nothing is posted (REQ-INV-072) · INV-422-LOAD-ROWS → message, text: RULE-INV-027 message (SRS) · INV-422-DOC-DATE-FUTURE → inline on docDate, text: RULE-INV-051 message (SRS) · INV-422-WAREHOUSE-REQUIRED → inline on warehousePk, text: RULE-INV-008 message (SRS) · INV-422-WAREHOUSE-INACTIVE → inline, text: RULE-INV-007 message (SRS) · INV-404-WAREHOUSE-NOT-FOUND → catalogue · generic. On success it navigates to SCR-INV-007 `/:id` of the returned adjustment |
| OPENING-FACADE | Owns the form state (rows with `rowNo`), the `line` navigation param, the row failures, the sheet-reading progress and derived loading. Operations: `downloadSheet()`, `loadSheet(file)` (reads the file in the browser, ADR-INV-035, and fills the rows; replacing existing rows asks for confirmation), `addRow`, `replaceRow`, `removeRow` (form state only), `post()` (ONE call) |
<!-- SUB:F2-SCR-INV-010:END -->

## F3 — Forms & Validators

**RF3.** Forms use `react-hook-form` with a `zod` resolver. Each schema mirrors the request schema of
`api-spec-inv.yaml`: its required fields, `maxLength`, `minimum` and `exclusiveMinimum`. Where the SRS RULE can be
checked in the browser, the schema adds it with the RULE's own message, in ar and en. The server stays the
authority: every server code reaches the same field through the F2 routing. Message keys are the RULE ids, and
the texts are the SRS A5 messages. Decimal fields accept at most 3 places (quantities and measures) or 4 places
(costs), per DEFAULT D-06 and RULE-INV-017. Validation runs on submit and then on change. Search forms validate
only date ranges, where "from" must not be after "to"; the message is «تاريخ البداية بعد تاريخ النهاية.» /
"The start date is after the end date.".

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-001:START traces=SCR-INV-001,REQ-INV-003,REQ-INV-004,REQ-INV-009,REQ-INV-029,REQ-INV-031,AC-INV-004,API-INV-001,API-INV-003,API-INV-004 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-001 — Warehouses
- `warehouseSearchSchema`: `code` ≤ 20, `name` ≤ 100, `active` ∈ {ACTIVE_ONLY, ALL}.
- `warehouseFormSchema`:
  - `nameAr`: required, 1–100; empty → «اسم المستودع بالعربية مطلوب.» / "The warehouse name (Arabic) is required.".
  - `nameEn`: ≤ 100, optional.
  - `branchPk`: optional; required on update, and the record's value is kept when the field is hidden (REQ-INV-029, REQ-INV-031).
  - `code`: display only, never part of the form value (RULE-INV-001).
- Name uniqueness (RULE-INV-002) is a server check, shown inline on `nameAr`.
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-001:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-002:START traces=SCR-INV-002,REQ-INV-022,REQ-INV-023,REQ-INV-028,AC-INV-026,API-INV-009,API-INV-011,API-INV-012 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-002 — Branches
- `branchSearchSchema`: `code` ≤ 20, `name` ≤ 100, `active`.
- `branchFormSchema`:
  - `nameAr`: required, 1–100; empty → «اسم الفرع بالعربية مطلوب.» / "The branch name (Arabic) is required.".
  - `nameEn`: ≤ 100.
  - `code`: display only (RULE-INV-010).
- Name uniqueness (RULE-INV-011) is a server check.
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-002:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-003:START traces=SCR-INV-003,UXD-INV-001,UXD-INV-002,REQ-INV-039,API-INV-016 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-003 — Stock balances
- `balanceSearchSchema`:
  - `variantPk` / `itemPk`: from the pickers (UXD-INV-001, UXD-INV-002).
  - `term`: ≤ 64, a scanned barcode.
  - `warehousePk`, `lotPk`: from the lookups.
  - `nonZero`: boolean.
- A change of any filter resets `page` to 0. No entry form.
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-003:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-004:START traces=SCR-INV-004,UXD-INV-004,REQ-INV-075,API-INV-018 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-004 — Stock move history
- `moveSearchSchema`:
  - `variantPk`: from UXD-INV-004.
  - `warehousePk`, `lotPk`.
  - `moveTypeCode`: an INV_MOVE_TYPE option.
  - `docNo`: ≤ 30.
  - `sourceDocTypeCode` (an INV_SOURCE_DOC_TYPE option) and `sourceDocRef` (integer): both or neither; set by the document jumps only.
  - `dateFrom` ≤ `dateTo`, both ISO dates.
- No entry form (REQ-INV-055).
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-004:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-005:START traces=SCR-INV-005,REQ-INV-139,UXD-INV-005,REQ-INV-014,REQ-INV-078,REQ-INV-079,REQ-INV-082,REQ-INV-084,REQ-INV-086,REQ-INV-122,AC-INV-090,AC-INV-093,API-INV-020,API-INV-022,API-INV-023 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-005 — Transfers
- `transferSearchSchema`: `docNo` ≤ 30, date range, `fromWarehousePk`, `toWarehousePk`, `statusCode` (an INV_DOC_STATUS option).
- `transferFormSchema`:
  - `fromWarehousePk` and `toWarehousePk`: required. Equal values give a refinement on `toWarehousePk`, text: RULE-INV-016 message (SRS) (REQ-INV-082).
  - `docDate`: date, defaulted to today; a date after today → refinement, text: RULE-INV-051 message (SRS) (the server checks the tenant's today).
  - `noteText`: ≤ 500.
  - `lines`: array. Two lines with the same `variantPk` and `lotPk` give a refinement on the second line, text: RULE-INV-048 message (SRS).
- `transferLineSchema` (the one-line drawer):
  - `variant`: required; empty → «اختر متغيّر الصنف.» / "Choose the Variant.".
  - `quantity`: > 0 with ≤ 3 decimals, text: RULE-INV-017 message (SRS).
  - `lotPk`: required when `lotExpiryFl` and the Item is `lotTrackedFl`, text: RULE-INV-037 message (SRS) (AC-INV-093), unless the user chose «بدون تشغيلة» / "Without a lot"; the quantity bound (the lot-less stock of the from-warehouse) is the server's (REQ-INV-139, ADR-INV-051).
  - `measureQty`: > 0, required when `dualQuantityFl` and the Item is `dualQuantityFl`, text: RULE-INV-040 message (SRS) (REQ-INV-122); ≤ 3 decimals, text: RULE-INV-017 message (SRS).
  The tracking flags come from ITEM-TRACKING-LOOKUP. The drawer's confirm validates the line and returns it to the form state.
- Post asks for no input. "At least one line" (RULE-INV-031) is also checked before Post is offered.
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-005:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-006:START traces=SCR-INV-006,REQ-INV-139,UXD-INV-006,REQ-INV-013,REQ-INV-017,REQ-INV-087,REQ-INV-088,REQ-INV-089,REQ-INV-090,REQ-INV-091,REQ-INV-095,REQ-INV-122,AC-INV-098,API-INV-026,API-INV-028,API-INV-029,API-INV-030 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-006 — Stock counts
- `countSearchSchema`: `docNo` ≤ 30, date range, `warehousePk`, `statusCode`.
- `countStartSchema`:
  - `warehousePk`: required when two or more warehouses are active, text: RULE-INV-008 message (SRS) (REQ-INV-017); null while one (REQ-INV-013).
  - `noteText`: ≤ 500.
- `scanSchema`:
  - `barcode` (≤ 64) or `variant`: one is required.
  - `countedQty`: ≥ 0 with ≤ 3 decimals, text: RULE-INV-047 message (SRS) (AC-INV-098).
  - `lotPk` and `countedMeasureQty`: required as in transfers, texts RULE-INV-037 and RULE-INV-040 — a lot-tracked line may choose «بدون تشغيلة» / "Without a lot" (REQ-INV-139).
  The barcode input is numeric-keyboard friendly (`inputmode="numeric"`) and accepts a scanner's Enter as submit (REQ-INV-090).
- `countLineEditSchema`: `countedQty` ≥ 0 (RULE-INV-047), `countedMeasureQty` ≥ 0, `version`.
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-006:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-007:START traces=SCR-INV-007,REQ-INV-139,UXD-INV-007,REQ-INV-010,REQ-INV-013,REQ-INV-017,REQ-INV-097,REQ-INV-098,REQ-INV-101,REQ-INV-102,REQ-INV-104,REQ-INV-105,REQ-INV-123,AC-INV-109,AC-INV-111,AC-INV-113,API-INV-034,API-INV-036,API-INV-037 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-007 — Stock adjustments
- `adjustmentSearchSchema`: `docNo` ≤ 30, date range, `warehousePk`, `reasonCode` (an INV_ADJUSTMENT_REASON option), `statusCode`.
- `adjustmentFormSchema`:
  - `reasonCode`: required, an active option other than OPENING_STOCK, which the reason select does not offer (only the opening stock load writes it — ADR-INV-047), text: RULE-INV-033 message (SRS) (AC-INV-113).
  - `docDate`: date, defaulted to today, on create only; a date after today → refinement, text: RULE-INV-051 message (SRS).
  - `warehousePk`: required on create when two or more are active, text: RULE-INV-008 message (SRS); null while one (REQ-INV-010, REQ-INV-013). Not editable after the first save.
  - `noteText`: ≤ 500.
  - `lines`: two lines with the same Variant and `lotNo` give a refinement, text: RULE-INV-048 message (SRS) (AC-INV-109).
- `adjustmentLineSchema`:
  - `variant`: required.
  - `quantityChange`: ≤ 3 decimals, text: RULE-INV-017 message (SRS). It must be ≠ 0 unless the Item is dual-quantity and `measureQtyChange` ≠ 0, text: RULE-INV-034 message (SRS) (AC-INV-111, REQ-INV-123).
  - `unitCost`: ≥ 0 with ≤ 4 decimals, text: RULE-INV-025 message (SRS); only on increase lines, optional (REQ-INV-102).
  - `lotNo`: ≤ 40.
  - `lotExpiryDate`: required with `lotNo` on an increase line of a lot-tracked Item, text: RULE-INV-035 message (SRS) (REQ-INV-105).
  - `lotNo` on a decrease line of a lot-tracked Item: required, text: RULE-INV-037 message (SRS), unless the user chose «بدون تشغيلة» / "Without a lot" (REQ-INV-139 — the server bounds the decrease by the lot-less stock).
  - `measureQtyChange`: ≤ 3 decimals, text: RULE-INV-017 message (SRS); required and ≠ 0 when `quantityChange` ≠ 0 and the Item is dual-quantity with dualQuantity on, text: RULE-INV-040 message (SRS) (REQ-INV-122).
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-007:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-008:START traces=SCR-INV-008,UXD-INV-008,REQ-INV-108,REQ-INV-109,REQ-INV-116,API-INV-040,API-INV-042 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-008 — Lots and near expiry
- `lotSearchSchema`: `variantPk`, `code` ≤ 40, `warehousePk`, `expiryFrom` ≤ `expiryTo`, `nearExpiryOnly`.
- `lotFormSchema`:
  - `expiryDate`: required; empty → «أدخل تاريخ انتهاء الصلاحية.» / "Enter the expiry date.".
  - `nameAr`, `nameEn`: ≤ 100.
  - `version`: required.
- An earlier or later expiry is allowed (REQ-INV-108).
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-008:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-009:START traces=SCR-INV-009,UXD-INV-009,UXD-INV-010,REQ-INV-124,REQ-INV-125,REQ-INV-128,REQ-INV-129,AC-INV-141,API-INV-043,API-INV-045 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-009 — Item stock settings
- `itemSettingsSearchSchema`: `itemPk` (from UXD-INV-009) or `term` ≤ 100, `lotTracked`, `dualQuantity`.
- `itemSettingsFormSchema`:
  - `item`: required on a new record; empty → «اختر الصنف.» / "Choose the Item.".
  - `lotTrackedFl`: boolean, sent `false` while lotExpiry is off and the control is hidden (REQ-INV-128).
  - `dualQuantityFl`: boolean, likewise.
  - `measureUomCode`: required when `dualQuantityFl` is true, text: RULE-INV-041 message (SRS) (AC-INV-141).
  - `version`: nullable.
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-009:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-010:START traces=SCR-INV-010,REQ-INV-140,REQ-INV-013,REQ-INV-017,REQ-INV-070,REQ-INV-071,REQ-INV-072,REQ-INV-074,REQ-INV-105,REQ-INV-122,AC-INV-078,AC-INV-081,API-INV-047 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-010 — Opening stock
- `openingStockSchema`:
  - `idempotencyKey`: set by the form, never edited by the user (ADR-INV-053).
  - `warehousePk`: required when two or more are active, text: RULE-INV-008 message (SRS).
  - `rows`: 1–1000 entries, text: RULE-INV-027 message (SRS) (AC-INV-078).
- `openingRowSchema`:
  - `rowNo`: integer ≥ 1.
  - `barcode`: required, ≤ 64; empty → «أدخل الباركود.» / "Enter the barcode." (v1 names a Variant by barcode only — ADR-INV-035).
  - `quantity`: > 0, text: RULE-INV-026 message (SRS); ≤ 3 decimals, text: RULE-INV-017 message (SRS).
  - `unitCost`: required and ≥ 0, text: RULE-INV-026 message (SRS) (REQ-INV-074, AC-INV-081); ≤ 4 decimals, text: RULE-INV-025 message (SRS).
  - `lotNo`: ≤ 40.
  - `lotExpiryDate`: required with `lotNo`, text: RULE-INV-035 message (SRS).
  - `measureQty`: ≥ 0 with ≤ 3 decimals, text: RULE-INV-017 message (SRS).
- Rows read from the sheet go through the same schema before posting. Rows that fail are listed by `rowNo` with their message, and nothing is sent until they pass (REQ-INV-072). Variant resolution is the server's (ADR-INV-035).
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-010:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-011:START traces=SCR-INV-011,REQ-INV-065,REQ-INV-118,REQ-INV-119,AC-INV-133,API-INV-049 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-011 — Inventory settings
- `settingsSchema`:
  - `allowNegativeStockFl`: boolean.
  - `nearExpiryDays`: a whole number from 1 to 365; otherwise → «أدخل عدد أيام من 1 إلى 365.» / "Enter a number of days from 1 to 365." (REQ-INV-119, AC-INV-133). The saved value stays unchanged until the field passes.
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-011:END -->

<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-012:START traces=SCR-INV-012,UXD-INV-011,REQ-INV-063,API-INV-050 -->
### F3 · SCR-INV-012 — Stock valuation
- `valuationSearchSchema`:
  - `variantPk` / `itemPk`: from UXD-INV-011.
  - `term`: ≤ 64, a barcode.
  - `nonZero`: boolean.
- No entry form.
<!-- SUB:F3-SCR-INV-012:END -->
<!-- PHASE:F3:END -->
